output.review_comment: The pull request makes significant algorithmic changes without explanation. Most concerning is the switch from round-half-up (original formula) to banker's rounding (new conditional logic), which is a very specific choice that differs from the original behavior. Without seeing the docstring to verify this matches the intended behavior, this appears to be test-specific logic. Additionally: (1) No PR description provided, (2) New validation constraint added without justification, (3) No confirmation that tests actually pass, (4) The modulo wrapping is correct but undocumented. Before approval, provide: a description explaining changes, verification against docstring, test results, and clarification of the banker's rounding choice.
